name: overlay-accent-stays-fixed-across-a-space-switch
description: The retired 'space' accent used to hand the overlay's --ov-accent to the active space's tint. With the option gone, a chosen theme has to stay put across a space switch instead of drifting with the tint. settings.json pins overlayAccent to nord; the fixture's first two spaces carry different tints (oceanBlue, atriumSolarized) so the switch is a real one, not a vacuous same-space read. Reads the sidebar document before and after cmd+2 moves the window from space 0 to space 1: --ov-accent and the atrium-theme-nord class must read identically both times, while --atrium-space-tint - pushed unconditionally, independent of the accent - is asserted to actually change, proving the switch did something and the fixed accent is not fixed by accident.

actions.note: the theme push runs after the document is up
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot

actions.expression: (() => { const r = document.documentElement; const s = getComputedStyle(r); const t = (n) => (s.getPropertyValue(n) || '').trim().toLowerCase(); return 'accent=' + t('--ov-accent') + ' tint=' + t('--atrium-space-tint') + ' classes=' + [...r.classList].filter((c) => c.startsWith('atrium-theme-')).join(','); })()
